spans.s: लड् (I) vt. or vi. 1P (pres. लडति) 1. To sport, to frolic, to dally; 2. to loll the tongue; 3. to harass, to annoy.
लड् (II) vt. 10U (pres. लाडयति-ते) 1. To fondle, to caress; 2. to spread.
लड् (III) vt. 1P, 10U (pres. लंडति, लंडयति-ते) 1. To speak; 2. to throw upwards, to toss up.
लाड् vt. 10U (pres. लाडयति-ते) 1. To throw, to toss; 2. to fondle, to caress; 3. to blame, to reproach.
लडह a. (f. हा) Handsome, beautiful (mostly found in Prākṛt passages).

लड्ड m. The same as लट्ट q.v.
लड्डु m.n. A kind of sweetmeat.
